outcome: timely initiation of breastfeeding (within one hour after birth)
breastfeeding problems (low milk supply, sore nipples, low birth weight, breast infections)
baby's first food (Ghuti, honey, green tea, formula milk)
cohort: 202 mothers of children in two rural Union Councils of District Sargodha, Pakistan
finding: Only 35.1% of mothers initiated breastfeeding within one hour after birth, with several factors like number of children, family type, delivery type, delivery location, knowledge about ANC, knowledge source, and social support significantly associated with timely initiation.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was mentioned as a breastfeeding problem experienced by 12% of mothers, but the specific birth weight criteria were not provided.
